#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "Starting OpenList as user $(id -u):$(id -g)..."

# Set umask if specified
if [ -n "$UMASK" ]; then
  umask "$UMASK"
fi

# Handle version command
if [ "$1" = "version" ]; then
  exec ./openlist version
fi

# Start aria2 if enabled
if [ "$RUN_ARIA2" = "true" ]; then
  echo "Starting aria2c in background..."
  aria2c \
    --enable-rpc \
    --rpc-allow-origin-all \
    --conf-path=/opt/aria2/.aria2/aria2.conf \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi

# Start OpenList server
echo "Starting OpenList server..."
exec ./openlist server --no-prefix

Redis is an open-source, in-memory data structure store that is used as a database, cache, and message broker. It provides a fast and flexible solution for storing and retrieving data, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of use cases, including real-time analytics, session management, and more.

Redis is used by Authentik, Authelia, oauth2-proxy.
